objective: Validate the frozen Phase 2A.2 period/domain mapping contract across the exact 186-company, six-quarter PIT-qualified official NSE universe before any event-decay or predictive research.
source_inputs: Phase 2A.1 all_target_events.json (2,365 PIT-qualified official filing events)
execution: Select latest PIT-qualified filing event per symbol/quarter/reporting-basis.
Use only official nsearchives.nseindia.com XBRL URLs.
Parse in memory and persist compact canonical-resolution evidence rather than the full fact inventory.
Checkpoint every document and resume without redownloading successful documents.
Preserve content SHA256, event id, provider sequence, source URL, availability, domain, concept, context, unit and normalized value for selected facts.
Record retrieval/parser failures and every unresolved preferred-concept ambiguity.
hard_gates: No production model or production app authority changes.
No automatic mapping expansion beyond the frozen contract.
Any scaled semantic ambiguity is a hard mapping-validation failure.
